name: zeroq-envelope-rubric
description: Scoring rubric for ZeroQ message envelopes and broadcast events.

checks.name: Envelope Header and Required Fields
checks.description: Verifies that envelope has non-empty id, topic, and numeric timestamp.

checks.name: Topic Naming Convention
checks.description: Topic must follow alphanumeric namespace format (e.g., 'telemetry.audio.stream') without whitespace or control chars.

checks.name: Payload Integrity
checks.description: Payload must be defined and non-null (cannot be empty undefined).

checks.name: Time-To-Live (TTL) Validity
checks.description: TTL must be a non-negative integer representing expiry in milliseconds.

checks.name: Headers & Retry Metadata
checks.description: Headers must be a valid key-value mapping and retryCount must be non-negative integer.
